title: Music & Instruments
description: A dedicated home for musical learning at every age and level: instrument lessons, music theory, singing and vocal training, rhythm and ear training, world and classical music traditions, and modern music production — with curated links to legitimate YouTube, Pinterest, and audio resources rather than embedded copyrighted media.

music_theory.label: Music Theory
music_theory.description: Notes, scales, key signatures, chords, and harmony — the building blocks that let you read and understand any piece of music.

resources.title: Music Theory — free interactive lessons & exercises

singing_vocal_training.label: Singing & Vocal Training
singing_vocal_training.description: Breath support, pitch control, tone, and vocal health for anyone who wants to sing better, from first-timers to trained vocalists.

rhythm_ear_training.label: Rhythm & Ear Training
rhythm_ear_training.description: Training your internal sense of time and pitch — the skill that lets musicians play together, improvise, and learn music by ear.

world_music.label: World Music
world_music.description: Explore musical traditions from around the globe — from Indian classical ragas to West African percussion and Latin American rhythms.

classical_music.label: Classical Music
classical_music.description: The Western classical tradition, from Baroque counterpoint to Romantic symphonies — essential listening and theory for any serious musician.

modern_production.label: Modern Music Production
modern_production.description: Recording, mixing, and producing music with modern digital tools — DAWs, beat-making, mixing, and mastering basics.
